title: Profile helper text button text dark on dark theme
body:
Transferred from MilosKozak/AndroidAPS at request of @andyrozman

When using the profile helper in the current Dev build and every time I've previously tested, the button at the top of the screen shows black text on a dark background so it is barely visible.

I suspect this is just not adjusting at all to the dark mode.

https://photos.app.goo.gl/eNxD8nNpie5RxY1e9

It's link to ProfileHelperAppTheme style, but I don't know how to fix it.
I tried to use default AppTheme style (but AAPS crash), and I don't find which properties and setting to add/modify in ProfileHelperAppTheme to fix it.

@Philoul 
> It's link to ProfileHelperAppTheme style, but I don't know how to fix it.

I tried it too and I don't solved it :(
#

But the vertical-alignment of labels are improved.

Issue behind this: If the theme is a Material theme, the general Button will become a MaterialButton.
On a `MaterialButton` the `background` attribute alone will not work. `app:backgroundTint` should do it.
:) Thanks @guydavies for taking this over. Fixed, I hope.
